channel.title: Press Information Bureau - Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
channel.description: Press Releases from Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

item.title: Cabinet approves strategic incentive package for Deepwater and Ultra-Deepwater exploration under Samudra Manthan mission
item.description: The Union Cabinet has approved a dedicated fiscal framework to accelerate offshore deepwater drilling and subsea infrastructure in deep offshore basins including Krishna Godavari and Andaman sea.

item.title: Shri Hardeep Singh Puri launches OALP Bid Round X offering 28 exploration blocks in offshore basins
item.description: Minister of Petroleum and Natural Gas launched Open Acreage Licensing Programme Bid Round 10, unlocking over 100,000 sq km of offshore exploration acreage across deepwater and ultra-deepwater blocks.

item.title: ONGC announces new hydrocarbon discovery in offshore Krishna Godavari deepwater block
item.description: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) has made a significant natural gas discovery in deepwater well KG-DWN-98/2-M-1 in the Bay of Bengal, boosting domestic offshore reserves.

item.title: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana achieves 10 crore LPG connections milestone
item.description: Ministry of Petroleum celebrates nationwide LPG distribution milestone for rural households under PMUY scheme.
